{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if QA orders exist (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders, keep only converted orders
filtered_data = data[
    (data['converted'] == 1) &
    (data['status'] != 'refunded') &
    (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Verify remaining rows
print(f'Number of converted, non-refunded, non-QA orders: {len(filtered_data)}')

# Check channel distribution after filtering
distribution_after_filter = filtered_data['channel'].value_counts()
print(f'Channel distribution after filtering:\n{distribution_after_filter}')

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
segment_by_channel = filtered_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(f'Customer segment distribution by channel:\n{segment_by_channel}')"}
